mathWorkshop.title: Join and take away
mathWorkshop.goal: See how adding and taking away change a group.

tasks.prompt: Tap the three beans once each. How many are in the starting group?
tasks.feedback: There are three beans to start with.
tasks.hint: Tap each object once. A marked object has already been counted.

tasks.prompt: Three beans are ready. Add two more beans, then check the new group.
tasks.feedback: Three beans and two more make five: 3 + 2 = 5.
tasks.hint: Keep the three you started with. Add one, then one more.

tasks.prompt: Seven beans are ready. Take away two beans, then check what is left.
tasks.feedback: Taking two away from seven leaves five: 7 - 2 = 5.
tasks.hint: Remove one bean, then one more. Count only the beans that remain.

parentReview.en: Guided practice is ungraded. Completion records the child doing the activities, not a book-question score.

steps.title: Maths discovery 2
steps.prompt: Find one more and one less.
steps.hint: Think whether things join the group or leave it.
steps.explanation: One more moves forward; one less moves back.
steps.shortExplanation: One more moves forward; one less moves back.

steps.title: Maths discovery 3
steps.prompt: Start at 5 and count on 3. Where do you land?
steps.hint: Think whether things join the group or leave it.
steps.explanation: Three forward jumps from 5 land on 8.
steps.shortExplanation: Three forward jumps from 5 land on 8.

steps.title: Maths discovery 4
steps.prompt: Start at 9 and count back 4. Where do you land?
steps.hint: Think whether things join the group or leave it.
steps.explanation: Four backward jumps from 9 land on 5.
steps.shortExplanation: Four backward jumps from 9 land on 5.

steps.title: Maths discovery 5
steps.prompt: Choose the addition sentence for the two groups.
steps.hint: Think whether things join the group or leave it.
steps.explanation: Adding 4 blue dots and 3 orange dots makes 7.
steps.shortExplanation: Adding 4 blue dots and 3 orange dots makes 7.

steps.title: Maths discovery 6
steps.prompt: There are 8 cubes. Take away 3. How many remain?
steps.hint: Think whether things join the group or leave it.

steps.title: Maths discovery 7
steps.prompt: Match the words to the number sentence.
steps.hint: Think whether things join the group or leave it.
steps.explanation: Plus adds, minus takes away and equals means the same as.
steps.shortExplanation: Plus adds, minus takes away and equals means the same as.

steps.title: Maths discovery 8
steps.prompt: 8 cars were parked. 4 drive away. Choose the correct sentence.
steps.hint: Think whether things join the group or leave it.
steps.explanation: The cars leave, so take 4 away from 8.
steps.shortExplanation: The cars leave, so take 4 away from 8.

source.answerKeyText: No. Cars drove away, so it is taking away: 8 − 4 = 4.

steps.title: Maths discovery 9
steps.prompt: Mona has 7 sweets. Ali has 4. How many more does Mona have?
steps.hint: Think whether things join the group or leave it.
steps.explanation: Match the sweets in pairs. Mona has 3 without partners.
steps.shortExplanation: Match the sweets in pairs. Mona has 3 without partners.

source.answerKeyText: 3. If he says 7, line up 7 and 4 objects in pairs and count the ones without a partner.

steps.title: Maths discovery 10
steps.hint: Think whether things join the group or leave it.
steps.explanation: Add is the answer. The plus sign joins groups.
steps.shortExplanation: Add is the answer. The plus sign joins groups.

steps.title: Maths discovery 11
steps.hint: Think whether things join the group or leave it.
steps.explanation: 4 is the answer. Two backward jumps from 6 leave 4.
steps.shortExplanation: 4 is the answer. Two backward jumps from 6 leave 4.

steps.title: Maths discovery 12
steps.prompt: On a number line, taking away makes you jump...
steps.hint: Think whether things join the group or leave it.
steps.explanation: Backwards is the answer. Taking away moves toward smaller numbers.
steps.shortExplanation: Backwards is the answer. Taking away moves toward smaller numbers.

steps.title: Maths discovery 13
steps.hint: Think whether things join the group or leave it.
steps.explanation: 7 is the answer. One backward step from 8 reaches 7.
steps.shortExplanation: 7 is the answer. One backward step from 8 reaches 7.

steps.title: Maths discovery 14
steps.hint: Think whether things join the group or leave it.
steps.explanation: 5 is the answer. Adding nothing changes nothing.
steps.shortExplanation: 5 is the answer. Adding nothing changes nothing.

stickers.meaning: Put groups together to make more.

homeActivities.text: Make a floor number line with an adult. Start on a number and count forward or back by jumps. Compare two groups by pairing objects.
homeActivities.textAr: اعملوا خط أرقام على الأرض مع حد كبير. اقفوا على رقم ونطّوا لقدّام أو لورا وانتوا بتعدّوا. وقارنوا مجموعتين بإنكم تحطوا كل حاجة قصاد حاجة.
homeActivities.safety: An adult supervises. Keep small objects away from younger children. An adult handles scissors. Use water at the sink, away from electrical items.
homeActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. خلّي الحاجات الصغيرة بعيد عن الأطفال الأصغر، والكبير يمسك المقص. أنشطة المية تكون عند الحوض وبعيد عن الكهرباء.
